scientific_boundary: The preregistered transfer-only t_tot representation has zero K1 response when only primordial scalar tilt n_s is changed. Therefore K1 is not a resolvable nuisance direction in this transfer-only representation and no K1/GDM angle is scientifically defined there.
followup_rule: Any follow-up must be preregistered as a new representation that includes primordial-spectrum response for all compared families; Exp071M must remain invalid-for-science and must not be reclassified by relaxing the nonzero-vector integrity gate.
